newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SHAREHOLDERS OF FAILED BREDERO TO GET SMALL PAYOUT.
newsitem.headline: SHAREHOLDERS OF FAILED BREDERO TO GET SMALL PAYOUT.

text.p: Shareholders of bankrupt Verenigde Bedrijven Bredero NV (VBB) will receive a one-off liquidation payment of 5.00 guilders per share in December.
Vereffenaar VBB, which is handling the affairs of the defunct company, said the payment would be made on the basis of a 1989 agreement between VBB's creditors and shareholders.
It had already announced in February that VBB shareholders would receive a small payment but had not specified the amount.
The total payment to holders of the 375,204 VBB shares and depositary receipts will amount to 1.9 million guilders.
Vereffenaar VBB said the shares and the depositary receipts would become worthless once the payment had been made and that their listing on the Amsterdam bourse would therefore be discontinued.
